breakdown.description: For curved submerged surfaces, the horizontal component equals the hydrostatic force on the vertical projection (not the horizontal projection).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'using horizontal projection of the curved surface' for the horizontal force component, repeating the original error. The ground truth requires using the VERTICAL projection for the horizontal component.

breakdown.description: The vertical component is obtained from the weight of the fluid volume above the surface, not from projecting the area in the same way as the horizontal component.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not distinguish the vertical component method from the horizontal one, and says both use 'horizontal projection of the curved surface.' The ground truth requires the vertical component to be computed as the weight of the imaginary column of water above the curved surface up to the free surface, not from any projection area.
